newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo stocks end lower as investors await polls.
newsitem.headline: Colombo stocks end lower as investors await polls.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed slightly lower on Monday mainly on political uncertainty ahead of local government polls next month, brokers said.

The Colombo all share index closed 0.5 points lower at 617.07. Price declines outnumbered gains by 21 to 15. Commercial Bank rose five rupees to 147 due to better 1996 profit. Hatton National Bank fell three rupees to 247, Lanka Walltile 1.50 to 26.
"Apart from an extraordinary reason like the Commercial Bank results, prices will be flat until after the election," said Seedantha Kulatilleke, a trader at Allied Phillips Securities.
Shares of Commercial Bank soared after the bank said its net profit for 1996 rose by 31.7 percent to 433.36 million rupees.
The killing of a ruling party lawmaker this month shortly before nominations closed for the March 21 local government polls has sent investors to the sidelines, brokers said.
"Investors want to see if there will be more violence ahead of the election which will affect prices," said one broker.
Turnover was 23.7 million rupees supported by 30,300 Ceylon Brewery, 60,000 National Development Bank.
